source_authority: National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology (NCHMCT, Ministry of Tourism) — affiliated institute lists
central_ihm_note: Central IHMs are in ministries/c3_hospitality_tourism.json (22, batch C3).
excluded: Principal names, phone/fax numbers and e-mail addresses printed by NCHMCT are deliberately dropped: institution-level fields only (code, name, address, PIN, website, courses).
state_note: NCHMCT prints no separate state or city column. 'state' is derived from the LAST state/UT name (or common abbreviation such as U.P., M.P.) in the address, and is null when none is found; the address text is verbatim and sometimes inconsistent (e.g. '... Jodhpur Jaipur - 342001', Zaheerabad listed under 'Andhra Pradesh' though it is in Telangana). Many names are generic ('Institute of Hotel Management', 'Food Craft Institute'): take the city from the address in the batch.
